translations.source: Merge projects is available in Mocha Pro only!
translations.translation: 合并项目仅在 Mocha Pro 中可用！

translations.source: Would you like to open your last project?
Bezier splines are not supported for 360 video
translations.translation: 360 度视频不支持贝塞尔样条

translations.source: Do you want to permanently encrypt %1?

Are you sure?
All settings (except the Developer Menu) will be cleared
translations.translation:
是否确定？
所有设置（开发者菜单除外）都将被清除
许可错误：心跳检测失败

translations.source: You have recovered an autosaved project.
translations.translation: 已恢复一个自动保存的项目。
切换参数更改时自动渲染

translations.source: Allows you to change application preferences
Specify a project file and save the project
Finish the spline being edited as closed
translations.translation: 将正在编辑的样条作为闭合样条完成

translations.source: Finish the spline being edited as open
translations.translation: 将正在编辑的样条作为开放样条完成
切换选中控制点的启用状态(&V)

translations.source: Step to the Next Control Point
Step to the Previous Control Point

translations.translation: 查看在线帮助（需要互联网连接）

translations.source: View release notes for this version

translations.translation: 查看在线 Python 文档
查看离线 Python 指南

translations.source: Merge another project into the current
translations.translation: 将其他项目合并到当前项目
创建 X 样条图层(&X)
创建 X 样条图层工具
选择新建的 X 样条图层
向图层添加 X 样条
选择新建的贝塞尔图层
向图层添加贝塞尔样条
将一个图层关联至另一个图层

translations.source: Close all selected splines or the spline being created (if any)
translations.translation: 闭合所有选中样条或当前正在创建的样条

translations.source: Open all selected splines or the spline being created (if any)
translations.translation: 打开所有选中样条或当前正在创建的样条

translations.source: Contextual copy action depends on selected widget
translations.translation: 根据选中的控件执行复制

translations.source: Contextual paste action depends on selected widget
translations.translation: 根据选中的控件执行粘贴

translations.source: Paste mesh key frames for selected points offset at current frame
translations.translation: 以当前帧为偏移基准，粘贴选中控制点的网格关键帧

translations.source: Contextual delete action depending on current focus
translations.translation: 根据当前焦点执行删除
激活／停用节点锁定许可证...

translations.source: Expand the planar surface(s) of selected layers to fill the entire frame
translations.translation: 将选中图层的平面表面扩展至整个画面

translations.source: Add magnetic shape to selected layer
translations.translation: 向选中图层添加磁性形状
向图层添加自由绘制形状(&R)

translations.source: Add freehand layer to selected layer
translations.translation: 向选中图层添加自由绘制形状
新建矩形 X 样条图层(&X)
创建矩形 X 样条图层
新建椭圆 X 样条图层(&X)
创建椭圆 X 样条图层

translations.source: Add Rectangular X-&Spline Shape to layer
translations.translation: 向图层添加矩形 X 样条形状(&S)
添加矩形 X 样条

translations.source: Add Elliptical X-&Spline shape to layer
translations.translation: 向图层添加椭圆 X 样条形状(&S)
添加椭圆 X 样条

translations.source: Add Rectangular B&ezier Shape to layer
translations.translation: 向图层添加矩形贝塞尔形状(&E)

translations.source: Add Elliptical B&ezier shape to layer
translations.translation: 向图层添加椭圆贝塞尔形状(&E)

translations.source: Move inner and edge points together
translations.translation: 同时移动内部点和边缘点

translations.source: Move inner and edge points independently
translations.translation: 独立移动内部点和边缘点

translations.source: Export the project to a file
Neither the online nor offline manuals could be opened.
translations.translation: 无法打开在线或离线手册。

translations.source: Launch licensing tool to deactivate the license
translations.translation: 启动许可工具以停用许可证

translations.source: Launch licensing tool to activate a license
translations.translation: 启动许可工具以激活许可证

translations.source: Duplicate selected layers and all their keyframes
translations.translation: 复制选中图层及其全部关键帧

translations.source: Reset the surface to its default position
translations.translation: 将表面恢复到默认位置

translations.source: Group selected (or create new empty group)
translations.translation: 将选中项编组（或新建空组）

translations.source: Delete current layer in all frames
translations.translation: 在全部帧中删除当前图层

translations.source: Change '%1' property of the selected item(s)
Clip to show in the main window
Switch between equirectangular and rectilinear views
translations.translation: 在等距柱状与直线透视视图间切换

translations.source: The specified clip is a matte clip for another layer.
translations.translation: 指定素材已作为其他图层的蒙版素材。

translations.source: Set Layer In Point to current frame
translations.translation: 将图层入点设置为当前帧

translations.source: Reset Layer In Point to follow the project In Point
translations.translation: 重置图层入点以跟随项目入点

translations.source: Reset Layer Out Point to follow the project Out Point
translations.translation: 重置图层出点以跟随项目出点

translations.source: Set Layer Out Point to current frame
translations.translation: 将图层出点设置为当前帧

translations.source: Foreground insert clip for current layer
translations.translation: 当前图层的前景插入素材

translations.source: Whether to use clip as matte for layer, and if so, which layer
translations.translation: 是否将素材用作图层蒙版，以及用于哪个图层

translations.source: Layer from which tracking data is taken
Link splines to the base track, or to the adjusted track of the specified layer
translations.translation: 将样条关联至指定图层的基础跟踪或调整后跟踪

translations.source: Generate motion blur from spline or tracking motion
translations.translation: 根据样条运动或跟踪运动生成运动模糊

translations.source: Set a soft edge either for the selected points or the whole layer
translations.translation: 为选中控制点或整个图层设置柔化边缘

translations.source: Add a soft edge either to the selected points or the whole layer
translations.translation: 为选中控制点或整个图层增加柔化边缘

translations.source: Subtract a soft edge from either the selected points or the whole layer
translations.translation: 减少选中控制点或整个图层的柔化边缘

translations.source: Soft edge width in pixels: Positive values move the edge spline out, negative values move the main spline in
translations.translation: 柔化边缘宽度（像素）：正值向外移动边缘样条，负值向内移动主样条

translations.source: Keep all cached renders until the host program has quit. If you load the Mocha interface again, previously rendered material will still exist.
translations.translation: 在宿主程序退出前保留全部渲染缓存。再次打开 Mocha 界面时，之前渲染的素材仍然可用。
在宿主退出前保留渲染缓存(&R)

translations.source: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
Do you want to save the changes you made in the project%1?
translations.translation: 是否保存对项目%1所作的更改？

translations.source: Add or remove a keyframe at current position
translations.translation: 在当前位置添加或移除关键帧
删除时间轴中的全部关键帧

translations.source: Apply keyframe changes to all views
translations.translation: 将关键帧更改应用到全部视图

translations.source: Reset in point to start of clip
translations.translation: 将入点重置为素材起始帧

translations.source: Reset out point to end of clip
translations.translation: 将出点重置为素材结束帧
将时间轴缩放至入点／出点范围

translations.source: Zoom timeline to full frame range
translations.translation: 将时间轴缩放至全部帧范围

translations.source: Enable to operate on all views. Disable to operate only on the current view.
translations.translation: 启用后操作全部视图；禁用后仅操作当前视图。

translations.source: Add a new keyframe at current position
translations.translation: 在当前位置添加新关键帧

translations.source: Do you want to remove the entry from the recent file list?
translations.translation: 是否从最近文件列表中移除此条目？

translations.source: The %1 file will be encrypted and will no longer be available in the licensed version of %2!
translations.translation: 文件 %1 将被加密，并且将无法再用于 %2 的已授权版本！

translations.source:
The %1 file was created in %2 and will be converted to the latest %3 file format.

Do you want to replace %4?
translations.translation:
文件 %1 创建于 %2，将被转换为最新的 %3 文件格式。

是否替换 %4？

translations.source:
The project was created in %1 and has been converted to the latest file format.

%2 project files are not supported in earlier versions.

Would you like to save the project immediately with a new name?
translations.translation:
此项目创建于 %1，现已转换为最新文件格式。

早期版本不支持 %2 项目文件。

是否立即以新名称保存项目？

translations.source:
You have recovered an autosaved project.
Next time you save this project it will overwrite the original project file:

%1

Would you like to save the project immediately with a new name?
translations.translation:
已恢复一个自动保存的项目。
下次保存时将覆盖原始项目文件：

%1

是否立即以新名称保存项目？

translations.source: Zoom – to activate, hold down the assigned shortcut
translations.translation: 缩放 — 按住所分配的快捷键以启用

translations.source: Pan – to activate, hold down the assigned shortcut
translations.translation: 平移视图 — 按住所分配的快捷键以启用

translations.source: Rotate – to activate, hold down the assigned shortcut
translations.translation: 旋转 — 按住所分配的快捷键以启用

translations.source: Scale – to activate, hold down the assigned shortcut
translations.translation: 缩放 — 按住所分配的快捷键以启用

translations.source: Translate – to activate, hold down the assigned shortcut
translations.translation: 平移 — 按住所分配的快捷键以启用

translations.source:
%1

Version %2
Build Date %3

© 2001-%4 Boris FX and its licensors
Third-party license information
translations.translation:
%1

版本 %2
构建日期 %3

© 2001-%4 Boris FX 及其许可方
第三方许可信息

translations.source:
Please contact your system administrator
or technical support.
translations.translation:
请联系系统管理员
或技术支持。

translations.source:
Attempts were made to open the documentation at the following paths:
"%1"
"%2".
translations.translation:
曾尝试从以下路径打开文档：
"%1"
"%2"。

translations.source: <HTML>This feature is not included in your license. Export will be limited to 10 frames. Please contact %1 to upgrade.</HTML>
translations.translation: <HTML>您的许可证不包含此功能。导出将限制为 10 帧。请联系 %1 以升级。</HTML>

translations.source: Failed to launch %1. Please make sure this external program is installed in the location specified in preferences.
translations.translation: 无法启动 %1。请确认已将此外部程序安装在首选项所指定的位置。

translations.source:
You may be able to reconnect to the license server or dongle.
Make sure the license server is running, or the required dongle is plugged in, before attempting to reconnect.
If the reconnection attempt fails, wait 30 seconds before retrying.
translations.translation:
可以尝试重新连接许可证服务器或加密狗。
重新连接前，请确保许可证服务器正在运行，或所需的加密狗已插入。
若重新连接失败，请等待 30 秒后重试。

translations.source: If reconnection is not possible, either save or discard your changes.
translations.translation: 如果无法重新连接，请保存或放弃更改。
